# Blast V2 contracts

The canonical launch stack is published on Sui mainnet and remains paused.
[Deployment records](deployments/README.md) own its IDs, custody and release
gates; admin, partners, core and vault immutability awaits the final audit.

> Sui Move contracts behind Blast (blast.fun): a bonding-curve launchpad whose graduated coins migrate into Cetus or Bluefin pools, standalone overflow presales, partner fee codes, Boost leverage coins on Aftermath perpetuals, and the funSUI/blastSUI staking vault. Sui mainnet only.

**Integrators:** give your agent the self-contained reference for the product you build on: [presale](llms/presale.txt), [launchpad](llms/launchpad.txt), [shared core](llms/core.txt), [LP vault](llms/vault.txt), [partner codes](llms/partners.txt), [Boosts](llms/boosts.txt), [blastSUI and funSUI](llms/blast-sui.txt), [administration](llms/admin.txt), or the [delayed UpgradeCap manager](llms/upgrade-cap-manager.txt). Each covers how the product works end to end, plus every public function, type, event, and abort code of its packages and the packages they depend on, generated from source. [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) joins every product in one file for agents with a large context window.

This file routes agents. Find the branch that matches your task, open only what it names, and read Move source for anything concrete. Docs here record decisions and boundaries; functions, structs, events, errors, and constants are complete only in source.

Rules that hold on every branch:

- **Authority order.** Move source and tests decide behavior. `Move.toml`, `Move.lock`, and `Published.toml` decide dependencies and addresses. An ADR explains a decision; its status is in the [decision index](docs/decisions/README.md): accepted binds, proposed may already be implemented (confirm in source), superseded is history. Prose explains and never overrides source.
- **One package per `Move.toml`.** `sui/` is a workspace. Build, test, and verify from the package directory, through its `scripts/verify.sh` when it has one.
- **Live means `Published.toml`.** A first-party package has a canonical mainnet deployment only when its directory commits a `Published.toml`: call `published-at`, and name types and filter events by `original-id`. Publication records live under `deployments/sui/mainnet/`. A package without one is unpublished greenfield work whose ABI changes with its callers.
- **Mainnet only.** No testnet build, address, or rehearsal exists ([ADR 0103](docs/decisions/0103-mainnet-only.md)). Prove behavior with mainnet dev-inspect or real transactions.
- **Chain facts win.** Contract state and emitted events are canonical. The SDK derives previews and builds transactions from them; its output is never a contract input.
- **Compose in the PTB.** The launchpad, the presale, and Boosts core import no venue. Venues depend inward and hand core's non-droppable values back inside one programmable transaction block: a sale's `migrate` returns a `blast_core::migration::Migration` and the next command passes it to the sale's venue.

## Route by task

- Integrator reference: explaining or calling any function, object, event, or abort code. Open the product's file under [llms/](llms/), or [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for several products. Generated by `scripts/gen_llms.py` from the Move packages and the hand-written guides in [docs/llms/](docs/llms/AUTHORING.md), which an agent that browses can read one at a time; never edit the generated files by hand.
- [Contributor rules](AGENTS.md): editing, refactoring, or reviewing `.move` code. Owns style, module layout, error numbering, the required Sui Move skills, and which doc each kind of change loads.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): explaining how the system fits together. Package boundaries, dependency direction, launch lifecycle, allocation and payouts, migration, upgrade posture.
- [Blast SDK](https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-sdk): building transactions or reading state from an app. TypeScript builders, BCS decoders, exact previews, and event replay for the launchpad, migrators, presale, partners, and admin (`@interest-protocol/blast-sdk`; private repository).
- [Explorer naming](docs/explorer-naming.md): decoding a `0x…::module::Struct` string seen in an explorer, wallet, or event stream. Maps every visible coin, object, role, and event type to its package; [ADR 0085](docs/decisions/0085-explorer-visible-type-naming.md) owns the rule.
- Indexing events: read the emitting package's source. A package that defines `blast_events::Event<T>` wraps every payload in that envelope; the others emit payload structs directly, so check before writing a filter. Native checkpoint, transaction, and event order sequences everything; no package `init` emits an event ([ADR 0058](docs/decisions/0058-eventless-package-initialization.md)).
- [Vectors](docs/vectors/README.md): checking arithmetic, rounding, or SDK parity. Chain-neutral numerical vectors and the rules for regenerating them; rates use the one validated basis-points unit, `blast_core::bps::Bps` ([ADR 0137](docs/decisions/0137-shared-launch-stack-core-vault-and-venues.md)).
- [Release verification](docs/testing.md): proving a change is releasable. Package gates, vector rules, the external venue gate, and what counts as evidence.
- [Security audits](audits/README.md): audit coverage. The fresh launch stack has no audit yet; earlier reports covered code that no longer exists.
- [Deployment records](deployments/README.md): publishing or upgrading. Record format and post-publish steps; then the package's own `DEPLOYING.md` or `UPGRADING.md`.
- [Venue dependencies](sui/migrators/DEPENDENCIES.md): Cetus or Bluefin package IDs, pinned ABIs, and the mainnet dev-inspect matrix. A vendor package's README names its own venue objects.
- [Protocol scope](docs/protocol-scope.md): whether a mode, role, or recovery path is deliberately absent, and what admitting a new one requires.
- [Domain language](CONTEXT.md): launcher, creator recipient, Blast account, and claimant.
- Stating a guarantee or trust assumption to a user: take the custody, upgrade, and authority wording from the package README and [architecture](docs/architecture.md#upgrade-posture). Describe vault-held LP as held by upgradeable packages (`blast_vault`, and `blast_migrators`, whose venues borrow the position) with no withdrawal path, never as permanently locked ([release verification](docs/testing.md)).

- [Utility contracts and SDK](docs/utilities.md): immutable OTC and vesting packages, their mainnet provenance, and the utility TypeScript SDK.

## Packages

Each line gives the directory, the on-chain package name, its boundary, and where to read next.

- [Launchpad](sui/launchpad/README.md) (`blast_fun`): bonding-curve launches from ticket to migration. Lifecycle `[OpeningRound ->] Live -> MigrationReady -> Migrated`, curve, trade and migration fees, creator caps, Quote admission, partner fee ledger. ADRs [0088](docs/decisions/0088-reusable-launch-accounting-and-atomic-migration.md), [0090](docs/decisions/0090-minimal-launchpad-surface.md), [0092](docs/decisions/0092-creator-picks-the-virtual-quote.md), [0093](docs/decisions/0093-optional-opening-round.md), [0098](docs/decisions/0098-launch-creation-fee-and-partners.md), [0105](docs/decisions/0105-permissionless-launch-fee-claims.md).
- [Launch ticket template](sui/launch_ticket_template/README.md) (`launch_ticket_template`): compiler input for every launched coin. The SDK patches its constants; publishing it mints the supply into a `LaunchTicket`. [ADR 0051](docs/decisions/0051-generated-meme-package-template.md).
- [Presale coin template](sui/presale_coin_template/README.md) (`presale_coin_template`): compiler input for every presale sale token. The SDK patches its constants; publishing it registers the currency through `blast_presale::sale_token::new`, which seals the `TreasuryCap` under the presale. [ADR 0138](docs/decisions/0138-sealed-treasury-caps-and-venue-admissions.md).
- [Coin template](sui/coin_template/README.md) (`coin_template`): compiler input for a standalone coin that never launches on Blast. The SDK patches its metadata, supply, supply mode, and recipients; publishing it registers the currency and delivers the supply and capabilities. No Blast dependency. [ADR 0108](docs/decisions/0108-standalone-coin-template.md).
- [Migrators](sui/migrators/README.md) (`blast_migrators`): the Cetus and Bluefin venues for both products. Prepares each sale's coin at its venue tier, redeems the `Migration` the product's own `migrate` returns in the same PTB, creates the pool and the `blast_vault` vault, and runs LP-fee collection, auto-LP, and buyback-and-burn through the vault. Imports no product. Always upgradeable; a vault upgrade forces its relink. ADRs [0091](docs/decisions/0091-fee-split-buyback-and-burn.md), [0100](docs/decisions/0100-single-cetus-route-with-checked-retype.md), [0137](docs/decisions/0137-shared-launch-stack-core-vault-and-venues.md).
- [Presale](sui/presale/README.md) (`blast_presale`): standalone overflow presales with the shared product roles and version-gated compatible upgrades. Commitments, one proportional fill, payouts, and a permissionless `migrate` that returns the `Migration` for the sale's venue (the `blast_migrators` venues or a vendor); LP and holder rewards live in `blast_vault`; [DEPLOYING.md](sui/presale/DEPLOYING.md). ADRs [0099](docs/decisions/0099-standalone-overflow-presale.md), [0102](docs/decisions/0102-presale-creation-allowlists.md), [0104](docs/decisions/0104-external-presale-migrators-and-vendor-packages.md), [0106](docs/decisions/0106-presale-partners.md), [0137](docs/decisions/0137-shared-launch-stack-core-vault-and-venues.md).
- [Presale testkit](sui/presale_testkit/) (`blast_presale_testkit`): the `TEST_SUI` Quote and sale tokens for mainnet presale end-to-end runs; a test asset only.
- [Partners](sui/partners/README.md) (`blast_partners`): partner codes (canonical immutability deferred). A partner earns a share of Blast's fee on the flow it brings; Blast's changes to a partner's share or managing cap wait seven days. [Partner guide](docs/partner-codes.md), [ADR 0095](docs/decisions/0095-partner-codes.md).
- [Admin](sui/admin/) (`blast_admin`): singleton ACL (canonical immutability deferred) with typed roles, the delayed-notice primitives, and the generic `PackageVersion<Marker>` and `PackageAdmin<Marker>` every upgradeable launch package uses. Every Blast package signs in through it; read [ADR 0097](docs/decisions/0097-one-singleton-acl-with-typed-roles.md), then source (no README).
- [Blast SUI](sui/blast_sui/README.md) (`blast_sui`): single-validator funSUI and blastSUI liquid-staking vault with its own deployment and upgrade runbooks. [ADR 0053](docs/decisions/0053-single-validator-funsui-and-blastsui.md).
- [Boosts](sui/boosts/README.md): leverage coins `BlastBoost<Product>` backed by Aftermath perpetuals. `core` (`blast_boosts_core`) holds immutable policy and accounting, `products` (`blast_boosts_products`) the product tags, `aftermath_adapter` (`blast_boosts_aftermath`) vaults, currencies, and venue custody. Load the [implementation rules](docs/leverage-implementation-lessons.md) before any change and the [release-candidate record](docs/leverage-active-release-candidate.md) for release state. ADRs [0064](docs/decisions/0064-aftermath-backed-leverage-coins.md), [0073](docs/decisions/0073-series-one-adapter-owned-vaults.md), [0087](docs/decisions/0087-vault-issuance-activated-in-one-transaction.md).
- [Core](sui/core/README.md) (`blast_core`): shared money vocabulary (canonical immutability deferred) below both products, the vault, and the venues: `Bps`, recipients and payout, the fee split, the protocol-fee ledger, the treasury, Merkle proofs, the `VenueTicket`/`Migration`/`VaultTerms` hand-off, `OwnerProof`, and the product roles. [ADR 0137](docs/decisions/0137-shared-launch-stack-core-vault-and-venues.md).
- Vault (`sui/vault`, `blast_vault`): LP custody for every migrated sale of either product: the fee split, Blast's share and the partner hold, auto-LP and buyback balances, holder-reward rounds, and owner claims through an `OwnerProof`. Upgradeable now, made immutable after audit; see the [vault reference](llms/vault.txt).
- [Vendors](sui/vendors/README.md): one-off partner venues over `blast_core`. A vendor issues the `VenueTicket` a presale redeems at creation and redeems the sale's `Migration` from the PTB; it imports no product, and the presale `VenueAdmin` admits its witness.

The presale is a separate product. It shares no state or code with the launchpad; both build on `blast_core`, take the product roles from `blast_core::blast_domain`, migrate through venues that import neither, and keep LP in `blast_vault::vault::Vault`. Answer presale questions from `sui/presale`, the packages its `Move.toml` names, and the venue and vault it migrates into, never from launchpad code.

Outside the product surface: `scratch-sui/` (parked native DEX), every `interfaces/` directory (local stubs of external venue ABIs that prove types, never behavior), and the `tests/`, `ptb_tests/`, and `sui/boosts/composition_tests/` test packages.

## External dependencies

- [Blast SDK](https://github.com/interest-protocol/blast-v2-sdk): mirrors this repository's ABIs; after an ABI change here, its fixtures need regenerating.

## Optional

- [Decision index](docs/decisions/README.md): every ADR with its status, plus the open premises still awaiting falsification tests.
- [Leverage terminal record](docs/leverage-terminal-local.md): Boost shutdown, cash claims, and replay.
- [Research](docs/research/): dated research and audits behind earlier decisions. Background only; accepted ADRs and source supersede it.

- [Delayed UpgradeCap manager](sui/upgrade_cap_manager/README.md): framework-only native cap custody with a fixed 48-hour notice for digest-bound upgrades or terminal immutability. Independently verify the manager publication is immutable before enrollment; no publication is recorded.
